# Importing and Loading the Dataset

```{python}
import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv("C:/Users/Udith P Kidiyoor/Downloads/c4_epa_air_quality.csv")
data.head(10)
```

# Inspecting Dataset Information

```{python}
data.info()
```

# Checking Dataset Dimensions

```{python}
data.shape
```

# Converting Date Column and Generating Descriptive Statistics

```{python}
data["date_local"] = pd.to_datetime(data["date_local"])
data.describe()
```

# Checking for Missing Values

```{python}
data.isna().sum()
```

# Identifying Rows Containing Missing Values

```{python}
mask = data.isna()
mask = mask.any(axis=1)
```

# Extracting Rows with Missing Values

```{python}
nulls = data[mask]
nulls
```

# Calculating the Population Mean AQI

```{python}
population_mean = data["aqi"].mean()
population_mean
# 6.757692
```

# Creating a Random Sample

```{python}
sample_data = data.sample(n=50, replace=True, random_state=42)
sample_data
```

# Calculating the First Sample Mean

```{python}
sample_mean1 = sample_data["aqi"].mean()
sample_mean1
# 5.54
```

# Generating Multiple Sample Mean Estimates

```{python}
estimate_list = []

for i in range(10000):
    estimate_list.append(
        data["aqi"].sample(n=50, replace=True).mean()
    )

estimate_df = pd.DataFrame({"estimate": estimate_list})
```

# Inspecting the Sampling Distribution Data

```{python}
estimate_df.head()
```

# Calculating the Mean of Sample Means

```{python}
sample_mean = estimate_df.mean()
sample_mean
# 6.754114
```

# Visualizing the Sampling Distribution

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))

sns.histplot(
    estimate_df["estimate"],
    color="darkorange",
    kde=True
)

plt.axvline(
    x=estimate_df["estimate"].mean(),
    color="green",
    label="Mean of Sample Means"
)

plt.axvline(
    x=population_mean,
    color="red",
    label="Population Mean"
)

plt.axvline(
    x=sample_mean1,
    color="black",
    label="First Sample Mean"
)

plt.title("Sampling Distribution of AQI Sample Means")
plt.xlabel("Sample Mean AQI")
plt.ylabel("Density")

plt.grid(True)
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()

plt.show()
```
